note.zh: 前半部分来自本站沙盒的真实报错（消息与代码逐字对应），后半部分是 Archicad 里最常见的环境问题。
note.en: The first half lists real sandbox errors (messages match the engine verbatim); the second half covers the most common Archicad environment issues.

message.zh: 无法识别的字符
message.en: Unrecognized character

cause.zh: 多半是在中文输入法下敲了全角符号：全角逗号、全角引号、全角括号，或者从文档里粘进了不换行空格。
cause.en: Usually a full-width symbol typed with an IME — full-width comma, quote or bracket — or a non-breaking space pasted from a document.

fix.zh: 切到英文输入法重敲该行；把全角 `，` `“”` 换成半角 `,` `""`。编辑器里全角符号看起来只胖一点点，很难用眼睛发现。
fix.en: Retype the line in an ASCII keyboard layout and replace full-width `，` `“”` with `,` `""`. Full-width marks are only slightly wider and very hard to spot.

message.zh: 字符串缺少结束引号
message.en: Unterminated string literal

cause.zh: 字符串只写了开头引号。常见于长文本换行后忘了补引号，或用中文引号包了英文内容。
cause.en: A string opens but never closes — often after wrapping a long line, or when Chinese quotes wrap English content.

fix.zh: 补齐结尾的 `"`；字符串里要出现引号本身，就把它拆成两段用 `+` 拼接。
fix.en: Add the closing `"`. To include a quote inside a string, split it into two parts and join with `+`.

message.zh: 赋值语句应为 "="
message.en: "=" expected in assignment

cause.zh: 把赋值写成了 `==`（C 语言习惯），或者变量和等号之间塞了别的东西。GDL 赋值只用单个 `=`。
cause.en: Assignment written as `==` (a C habit), or something sits between the variable and the equals sign. GDL uses a single `=`.

fix.zh: 赋值一律 `变量 = 表达式`；比较也在 IF 里用 `=`，GDL 没有 `==`。
fix.en: Always `variable = expression`; comparisons in IF also use `=` — GDL has no `==`.

message.zh: IF 语句未用 ENDIF 闭合 / 多余的 ENDIF / ELSE 没有对应的 IF
message.en: IF block not closed with ENDIF / Unexpected ENDIF / ELSE without matching IF

cause.zh: IF 与 ENDIF 数量对不上：嵌套时少写一个 ENDIF，或复制代码后多留了一个 ELSE。报错行号往往落在块尾，不是真正出错的那行。
cause.en: IF and ENDIF counts mismatch: a missing ENDIF in nested blocks, or a stray ELSE after copying code. The reported line is often the block end, not the real culprit.

fix.zh: 从最外层往下数配对；长脚本给每层加缩进，一眼就能看出哪层缺尾巴。
fix.en: Count pairs from the outermost level; indent each level so a missing tail is visible at a glance.

errors.bad:
IF w > 1 THEN
  BLOCK w, 0.6, 0.04
ELSE
  BLOCK w, 0.4, 0.04
errors.good:
IF w > 1 THEN
  BLOCK w, 0.6, 0.04
ELSE
  BLOCK w, 0.4, 0.04
ENDIF

message.zh: FOR 循环未用 NEXT 闭合 / NEXT 没有对应的 FOR / 缺少 "TO"
message.en: FOR loop not closed with NEXT / NEXT without matching FOR / "TO" expected

cause.zh: FOR 三件套写残了：漏 `TO`、漏 `NEXT`，或嵌套循环只写了一个 NEXT。
cause.en: The FOR trio is incomplete: a missing `TO`, a missing `NEXT`, or nested loops sharing one NEXT.

fix.zh: 写全 `FOR i = 1 TO n … NEXT i`；嵌套时每个 FOR 配一个自己的 NEXT，循环变量别复用同一个。
fix.en: Write the full `FOR i = 1 TO n … NEXT i`; in nested loops give each FOR its own NEXT and never reuse the same counter.

errors.good:
FOR i = 1 TO 4
  BLOCK 0.2, 0.2, 0.6
NEXT i

message.zh: WHILE 循环未用 ENDWHILE 闭合 / 多余的 ENDWHILE
message.en: WHILE loop not closed with ENDWHILE / Unexpected ENDWHILE

cause.zh: WHILE 与 ENDWHILE 不成对。另一种隐蔽情况：循环体里忘了推进循环变量，语法没错但会一直转到上限。
cause.en: WHILE and ENDWHILE do not pair up. A subtler case: the loop body never advances the counter, so it runs until the limit.

fix.zh: 补 ENDWHILE；并检查循环体里有没有 `i = i + 1` 这类推进语句。
fix.en: Add ENDWHILE, then check the body actually advances the counter.

errors.bad:
i = 1
WHILE i <= 4
  BLOCK 0.2, 0.2, 0.6
  i = i + 1
errors.good:
i = 1
WHILE i <= 4
  BLOCK 0.2, 0.2, 0.6
  i = i + 1
ENDWHILE

message.zh: GOSUB 找不到标签 / RETURN 没有对应的 GOSUB
message.en: GOSUB cannot find label / RETURN without matching GOSUB

cause.zh: 标签名拼错、标签少了结尾冒号，或者子程序里忘了 RETURN 就滑进了下一段代码。
cause.en: A misspelled label, a label missing its trailing colon, or a subroutine that falls through without RETURN.

fix.zh: 标签写成 `100:` 独占一行；每个 GOSUB 的子程序末尾配 RETURN，并在最后加 END 挡住顺序执行。
fix.en: Write the label as `100:` on its own line; end each subroutine with RETURN and add END so execution does not fall through.

message.zh: 命令 {cmd} 需要 {n} 个参数，实际 {m} 个
message.en: Command {cmd} expects {n} argument(s), got {m}

cause.zh: 参数个数不对。GDL 命令的参数用逗号分隔，全部写在同一语句里，换行不算结束。多写或少写一个都会被拦下。
cause.en: Wrong argument count. GDL separates arguments with commas and a line break does not end the statement, so one extra or missing value is caught.

fix.zh: 查速查表对准签名；长参数列表用行尾逗号续行，不要靠换行断句。
fix.en: Check the signature in the command index; continue long lists with a trailing comma instead of relying on line breaks.

message.zh: 未知命令 {cmd}
message.en: Unknown command {cmd}

cause.zh: 命令名拼错、用了别的语言的关键字，或者写了沙盒尚未实现的命令（如 `UI_DIALOG`、`REQUEST`）。
cause.en: A misspelled command, a keyword from another language, or a command the sandbox does not implement (`UI_DIALOG`, `REQUEST`).

fix.zh: 对照速查表确认拼写；沙盒不支持的 UI、文件、REQUEST 类命令，请在 Archicad 里验证。
fix.en: Confirm the spelling in the index. UI, file and REQUEST commands are unsupported in the sandbox — verify those in Archicad.

message.zh: 命令 {cmd} 参数序列非法：顶点数应为 3 的倍数
message.en: Command {cmd} invalid argument list: vertex count must be a multiple of 3

cause.zh: PRISM / REVOLVE 的顶点按「x, y, 状态码」三个一组，少写状态码或漏一个坐标，总数就不是 3 的倍数。
cause.en: PRISM / REVOLVE vertices come in triples (x, y, status); a missing status or coordinate breaks the multiple of three.

fix.zh: 每个顶点补齐 `x, y, s`：起点写 1，中间点写 0，最后一个点写 -1。
fix.en: Give every vertex `x, y, s`: 1 for the first, 0 for intermediate points, -1 for the last.

message.zh: 命令 {cmd} 参数序列非法：顶点数应为 2 的倍数
message.en: Command {cmd} invalid argument list: vertex count must be a multiple of 2

cause.zh: POLY2_ 这类 2D 多边形命令按「x, y」成对传点，漏了一个坐标。
cause.en: 2D polygon commands such as POLY2_ take x, y pairs; one coordinate is missing.

fix.zh: 数一遍逗号后的数值个数，成对补齐；末尾别忘了 `-1` 结束标记。
fix.en: Count the values after the commas, add the missing half of the pair, and keep the closing `-1`.

message.zh: 未定义变量 {name}
message.en: Undefined variable {name}

cause.zh: 变量用在了赋值之前。常见于把 `w` 写成 `W`（GDL 大小写不敏感，但拼错字母一样会漏），或参数名和脚本里的写法不一致。
cause.en: A variable is read before it is assigned — often a typo in the name, or a parameter name that does not match the script.

fix.zh: 把赋值挪到使用之前；参数名直接从参数表复制，避免手敲。
fix.en: Move the assignment above first use, and copy parameter names from the parameter table instead of retyping.

message.zh: 未知函数 {name}
message.en: Unknown function {name}

cause.zh: 函数名拼错，或者把命令当函数用了（命令不能出现在表达式里）。
cause.en: A misspelled function, or a command used where an expression is expected — commands cannot appear inside expressions.

fix.zh: 确认函数名与括号；`STR`、`ABS`、`ROUND` 这类才返回值，`BLOCK`、`ADD` 这类只执行。
fix.en: Check the name and parentheses; only functions like `STR`, `ABS`, `ROUND` return a value, while `BLOCK`, `ADD` just execute.

message.zh: 表达式结果不是数值
message.en: Expression did not evaluate to a number

cause.zh: 把字符串塞进了需要数值的位置。典型是字符串参数直接当尺寸用，没做 `STR` / 数值转换。
cause.en: A string ends up where a number is required — typically a text parameter used as a size without conversion.

fix.zh: 确认该参数在参数表里是长度/数值型；文本要参与计算，先转成数值或改用数值型参数。
fix.en: Check the parameter type in the parameter table; to compute with text, convert it or use a numeric parameter.

message.zh: 除数为零
message.en: Division by zero

cause.zh: 分母来自参数或用户输入，可能是 0。例如按「根数 - 1」算间距，用户把根数设成 1。
cause.en: A denominator comes from a parameter or user input and can be 0 — e.g. spacing from `n - 1` when the user sets n to 1.

fix.zh: 算之前先兜底：`IF n < 2 THEN n = 2`，或用 `MAX (n - 1, 1)` 保证分母不为 0。
fix.en: Guard before dividing: `IF n < 2 THEN n = 2`, or use `MAX (n - 1, 1)` so the denominator stays positive.

message.zh: 几何参数不能为负数
message.en: Geometric parameter cannot be negative

cause.zh: 尺寸参数相减后变负，例如「总宽 - 两侧板厚」在两块板已经比总宽还厚时。
cause.en: A size goes negative after subtraction, e.g. overall width minus two board thicknesses when the boards are thicker than the width.

fix.zh: 用 `MAX (expr, 0.001)` 保底，或在参数脚本里限制最小值。
fix.en: Use `MAX (expr, 0.001)` as a floor, or clamp the minimum in the parameter script.

message.zh: DEL 回退层数超过当前变换栈深度
message.en: DEL exceeds current transformation stack depth

cause.zh: DEL 的层数比已经压入的变换还多。常见于循环里 DEL 2，但这一轮只 ADD 了一次。
cause.en: DEL pops more levels than were pushed — typically `DEL 2` in a loop where only one ADD happened that pass.

fix.zh: 数清每轮的 ADD / ROT 次数，DEL 与之一致；不确定时用 `DEL TOP` 回到脚本开头。
fix.en: Match DEL to the ADD/ROT count of that pass; when unsure, `DEL TOP` returns to the script start.

message.zh: 循环次数超过安全上限（10000 次）
message.en: Loop iteration limit exceeded (10000)

cause.zh: 死循环：WHILE 的条件永远成立，或者循环变量在体内被改回去了。
cause.en: An infinite loop: the WHILE condition never fails, or the counter is reset inside the body.

fix.zh: 确认循环体每轮都让条件趋近结束；实在需要长循环，就改成 FOR 并明确次数。
fix.en: Make sure each pass moves the condition towards the end; for genuinely long loops use FOR with an explicit count.

errors.good:
FOR i = 1 TO 10
  BLOCK 0.2, 0.2, 0.6
NEXT i

message.zh: EXTRUDE 的挤出向量不能为零
message.en: EXTRUDE vector must not be zero

cause.zh: 挤出向量三个分量全为 0，等于没有方向，无法生成体。
cause.en: All three vector components are zero, so there is no direction to extrude along.

fix.zh: 至少给一个非零分量；只沿 +Z 挤出时直接用 `PRISM` 更省事。
fix.en: Give at least one non-zero component; for pure +Z extrusion use `PRISM` instead.

message.zh: REVOLVE 截面点的 y 坐标不能为负数 / 旋转角度不能为 0
message.en: REVOLVE profile points must have non-negative y / angle must not be zero

cause.zh: 旋转体的 y 就是回转半径，负数会翻到轴的另一侧；角度 0 则扫不出体。
cause.en: For a revolved solid y is the radius, so a negative value flips across the axis; an angle of 0 sweeps nothing.

fix.zh: 截面整体平移到 y ≥ 0；需要另一侧的形状，改变旋转角或镜像，不要写负半径。
fix.en: Shift the profile so y ≥ 0; for the other side change the sweep angle or mirror, never use a negative radius.

message.zh: OPEN 返回 -1，读不到文件
message.en: OPEN returns -1, the file cannot be read

cause.zh: 路径不对。默认相对当前工作目录，写在库部件里通常要加 `LIBRARY`，让路径相对库部件所在目录。
cause.en: Wrong path. By default it is relative to the working directory; inside a library part add `LIBRARY` so the path is relative to the part.

fix.zh: 把文件与部件放在同一目录，`OPEN` 参数串加 `LIBRARY`；先用 `IF ch > 0` 做兜底，避免后续命令报错。
fix.en: Keep the file next to the part and add `LIBRARY`; guard with `IF ch > 0` so later commands never run on a bad channel.

message.zh: UI 脚本报错或面板不显示
message.en: UI script errors or the panel stays empty

cause.zh: 把 UI 命令写进了 2D / 3D 脚本，或者控件名与参数名不一致，又或者用了不存在的 `UI_CHECKBOX`。
cause.en: UI commands placed in the 2D/3D script, a control name that does not match a parameter, or the non-existent `UI_CHECKBOX`.

fix.zh: UI 命令只放 UI 脚本页；`UI_INFIELD` 的名字必须与参数表完全一致；复选框改用 `UI_INFIELD{3}` 或两个单选按钮。
fix.en: Keep UI commands in the UI Script page; `UI_INFIELD` names must match the parameter table exactly; use `UI_INFIELD{3}` or radio buttons instead of a checkbox.

errors.good:
! 只写在 UI 脚本页
UI_DIALOG "Settings"
UI_INFIELD "w", 15, 40, 105, 20

message.zh: 平面图上看不到对象 / 抓不到热点
message.en: The object is missing in plan or has no grab points

cause.zh: 2D 脚本没写任何图形，或者 `HOTSPOT2` 的可见标志没开；也可能对象被 `DEL TOP` 提前清掉了。
cause.en: The 2D script draws nothing, `HOTSPOT2` visibility is not set, or the geometry was cleared by an early `DEL TOP`.

fix.zh: 2D 脚本至少画一个轮廓；热点至少有一个基准点（`1 + 128`）；检查 DEL 是否把内容一起删了。
fix.en: Draw at least one outline in the 2D script, include a base hotspot (`1 + 128`), and check that DEL did not remove the geometry.

message.zh: 材质显示不对 / 换了模板后全变白
message.en: Wrong material, or everything turns white after switching templates

cause.zh: 材质索引是模板相关的编号，硬编码 8 在别的模板里可能不存在；用 0 则是不继承材质。
cause.en: Material indices are template-specific; a hard-coded 8 may not exist in another template, and 0 means no inherited material.

fix.zh: 把材质做成整数参数由用户选，脚本里用 `MATERIAL matFrame`；或在 INDEX 里运行时查材质号。
fix.en: Expose the material as an integer parameter and use `MATERIAL matFrame`; or look the index up at runtime.
